title: Find the triple-bonded molecules which are carcinogenic.
question: Find the triple-bonded molecules which are carcinogenic.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT mb.molecule_id
FROM molecule_bond AS mb
WHERE mb.bond_type = '#'
  AND mb.label = '+'
